newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar slips as CenBank stands aside.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar slips as CenBank stands aside.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed slightly weaker at 470.50/471.75 per dollar Thursday, compared to 470.00/471.25 per dollar Wednesday, as the Central bank allowed moderate currency demand to push up the exchange rate, dealers said.
"The rate continues to rise. Many banks were short after yesterday and came in to buy today," one broker said.
The reasonably high currency demand met limited supply and was not covered by the Central Bank, brokers added.
Brokers said the Central Bank's apparently more relaxed approach to the exchange rate could see the bolivar continue to slip gently although a steep fall would not be permitted.
